name: Simaudio Moon
_refused: simaudio.com/en/terms-conditions/, read 2026-11-25 with curl. The prohibiting clause is the broadest in this register: « Any use, reproduction, distribution, display or transmission of the content of the Website without the prior written permission of their owner is strictly prohibited. » It names USE itself, not only copying - so it does not even leave the narrow path that a facts-only reading sometimes opens. A second clause covers the marks: « Logos and trademarks may not be used without the prior written permission of their owner. » robots.txt resolves from www.simaudio.com by 301 to simaudio.com and carries no Content-Signal and no reservation of rights. No product page was opened and no record will exist under this brand.
_it_can_be_lifted: « without the prior written permission of their owner » - conditioned, so Simaudio Moon belongs on the letter list. What is lost meanwhile: the MOON 280D, 390 and 790D, network players with DAC sections, which is the shape this catalogue is thinnest on - a converter and a renderer in one box, where the network path's ceiling and the socket's ceiling differ and almost no maker states both. The Bryston BDA-3.14 recorded the same day shows exactly that gap.
_a_fact_still_not_licensable: Recorded so the refusal is not over-read: the clause is a CONTRACTUAL layer, and it binds us because we fetched the page. It does not make the facts protectable - « the MOON 390 accepts 384 kHz over USB » is not licensable by anyone. If that figure reaches this catalogue through another inlet - an owner with the hardware, a probe, a manual obtained elsewhere - no clause on simaudio.com stands in the way. What is refused is taking it from THEIR PAGE.
_CE_REFUS_N_EST_PAS_NEUF: La note _refused ci-dessus a ete ecrite le 25/11 au soir comme s'il s'agissait d'un refus nouveau. IL NE L'EST PAS : _REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.moon_by_simaudio le portait deja, commite le meme jour, avec la meme conclusion et plus de detail - notamment ce qui a ete jete, que ma note ne disait pas. Les deux textes concordent, aucun n'est a retirer, et le registre reste l'autorite. C'est conserve parce que la cause est interessante : j'avais cru verifier le registre en cherchant une cle _refused dans database/brands/*.json, ou j'en ai compte dix-sept, alors que le registre vit dans le vocabulaire et comptait vingt-six marques. Trois marques remesurees pour rien, et une quatrieme - Okto Research - recoltee contre son refus. LE REGISTRE SE LIT DANS LE VOCABULAIRE.
